compiled_state.title: GREEN: Create worktree-session-head-sync.sh script
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

Create plugins/dso/scripts/worktree-session-head-sync.sh — a shell script that syncs a sub-agent worktree (initialized from main HEAD) to the session HEAD SHA.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Given:**
- SESSION_BRANCH env var contains the name of the session branch (e.g. worktree-20260511-110342)
- SESSION_HEAD env var contains the full SHA of the session HEAD commit
- The session branch is pushed to origin (accessible via git fetch)
- Script runs inside a sub-agent git worktree

**When:**
- worktree-session-head-sync.sh executes

**Then:**
- Runs: git fetch origin "$SESSION_BRANCH"
- Runs: git reset --hard "$SESSION_HEAD"
- Sub-agent worktree HEAD SHA equals SESSION_HEAD
- Script exits 0 on success, non-zero on git error

**Must pass the RED test from T1.**

## File Impact

### Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/worktree-session-head-sync.sh

## Done Definitions

- [ ] Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/worktree-session-head-sync.sh
- [ ] Script is executable (chmod +x applied immediately after creation)
- [ ] Script validates SESSION_BRANCH and SESSION_HEAD are set (exits non-zero with error message if absent)
- [ ] Script runs git fetch origin then git reset --hard
- [ ] T1 regression test passes GREEN
- [ ] Script uses mktemp for any temp files (not hardcoded /tmp paths)
- [ ] Script has no ShellCheck errors

## Retry Budget

Max 3 retry attempts. If T1 still fails after GREEN: read the test output carefully — do not modify the test to fit the implementation.
